scope: All :Bauteilgruppe nodes plus direct :Projekt attachments and the Bauteilgruppe process vocabulary reachable through HAT_RUECKBAUVERFAHREN, HAT_AUFBEREITUNG, IST_UNTERVERFAHREN_VON, and HAT_WIEDERVERWENDUNGSART. Nodes carry full property bag; edges carry topology only.

properties.name: Reinigung von Beton-Anhaftungen
properties.beschreibung: Remove screed, mortar, glue, insulation, plaster from concrete surfaces. ReCreate FI commercial pilot.

properties.name: Sägen von Betonfertigteilen
properties.beschreibung: Diamond/wire sawing to release precast elements from wet joints / in-situ overlay. ReCreate NL Prinsenhof.

properties.name: Bauteil-Tagging + Sortierung
properties.beschreibung: Labeling, provenance documentation, sortin by type/length/condition. Cross-cutting QA practice.

properties.name: Entrosten / Korrosionsbehandlung
properties.beschreibung: Rust removal + passivation + corrosion-grade evaluation + prep for protective systems.

properties.name: Fenster-Refurbishment (Beschläge + Dichtungen)
properties.beschreibung: Replace gaskets, hardware, drainage, frame fittings to make window functionally reusable. Process package.

properties.name: Glas-/Fensterelement-Prüfung + Sortierung
properties.beschreibung: Determine glass type, thickness, build-up, coating, gasket integrity. K.118 cataloguing logic.

properties.name: Hobeln, Schleifen, Fräsen (Holz)
properties.beschreibung: Surface and dimensional machining of timber: planing, sanding, milling. Can reduce cross-section.

properties.name: Festigkeitssortierung Holz
properties.beschreibung: Visual + machine grading of reused structural timber per EN 14081-1 + DIN 4074. Sorts into strength classes.

properties.name: Trocknung / Feuchtekonditionierung
properties.beschreibung: Controlled drying or moisture conditioning. Critical for mold/warping/adhesive prevention.

properties.name: Holz-Zuschnitt + Reparaturzuschnitt
properties.beschreibung: Cut off damaged ends / rot zones, trim to new lengths; add new connection geometry. Recypark Anderlecht glulam.

properties.name: Korrosionsschutz-Beschichtung / Neubeschichtung
properties.beschreibung: Application of new primer / topcoat / fire-protection coating after surface prep.

properties.name: Lehm sieben, brechen, anfeuchten, neu mischen
properties.beschreibung: Process clay/earth: sieve, crush, foreign-material removal, rehydrate, reformulate as plaster/mortar/fill. K.118.

properties.name: Materialsortierung & Chargenbildung (querschnittlich)
properties.beschreibung: Cross-material sorting, grouping into reusable batches, tagging origin/condition.

properties.name: Mauerwerk-Diamantsägen (Modulausschnitt)
properties.beschreibung: Diamond-saw cuts of larger masonry sections to reuse as modules (avoids single-brick separation). Resource Rows CPH.

properties.name: Mörtelentfernung bei Ziegeln
properties.beschreibung: Manual or mechanical removal of mortar residue. FCRBE: hammer, chisel, brush, vibrating plates. Cement mortar = hard.

properties.name: Naturstein-Reinigung, Schleifen, Zuschnitt
properties.beschreibung: Cleaning + polishing + cutting of natural stone slabs/blocks for reuse. K.118 granite facade → kitchens/toilets/balconies.

properties.name: Oberflächenbehandlung (Sammelkategorie)
properties.beschreibung: Parent category: cleaning, stripping, coating-removal, blasting, surface refinishing across materials.

properties.name: Sandstrahlen / Strahlreinigen
properties.beschreibung: Abrasive blasting to remove rust, scale, old coatings; surface prep for new corrosion protection.

properties.name: Zerlegung / Vereinzelung (Sammelkategorie)
properties.beschreibung: Parent category: sawing, cutting, separating elements from parent assemblies.
